A Pipedrive consultant is a specialist who sets up, migrates and automates Pipedrive for your sales team: pipeline stages, custom fields, automations, integrations and reporting. Pipedrive is easy to start, which is why so many accounts end up with ten pipelines, duplicate contacts and deals nobody updates. The right partner fixes the process first and the configuration second.

This guide compares 9 Pipedrive partners and consultants in 2026, using Pipedrive's Expert Marketplace, each firm's own site and its published pricing, all checked on 2026-10-21. You will find partner tiers, review counts, entry prices and a framework for choosing.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. Our case is scope: we set up Pipedrive and build the automation around it (enrichment, outbound, n8n jobs, AI agents) in one team. ManasFlow is not a listed Pipedrive partner. If you want a Platinum-tier firm, fixed published pricing or a team that will train your reps to run Pipedrive themselves, another firm below will suit you better, and we name it.
Best Pipedrive consultants: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall Pipedrive consultant for automation-first teams: Pipedrive setup plus the enrichment, outbound and n8n automation around it.
Sales Surge: Best for EU teams that want published pricing from a Platinum partner, with its own Pipedrive add-ons.
MinorCo: Best for learning to run Pipedrive yourself, through courses, coaching and done-for-you builds.
Motii: Best for Australia and New Zealand, especially teams that also use monday.com.
Automated Sales: Best for end-to-end sales process design in the UK, with 200+ Pipedrive projects claimed.
Flow Digital: Best low-cost entry, with a single paid session and the most reviews in the marketplace.
Axis Consulting: Best for migrations into Pipedrive from Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho and others.
Process Culture: Best for Australian SMBs that want process mapping before automation.
CRM Craft: Best for outsourced Pipedrive admin on a monthly plan.
Source: pipedrive.com/en/marketplace/partners profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. All listed firms showed a 5.0 rating. ManasFlow and CRM Craft are not listed in the marketplace.
Pipedrive has three partner tiers: Authorized, Gold and Platinum, based on how many sales, support, marketing and customer success certifications a firm holds.
Four firms on this list publish prices: Flow Digital ($297 session), MinorCo ($397 a month), CRM Craft ($1,250 for 10 hours) and Sales Surge (€2,950 implementation).
Check the tier in the directory, not on the firm's site. Flow Digital's site says Gold, while Pipedrive's marketplace lists it as Authorized.
The exact n8n flows, Claude Code setups, and prompts we ship for clients, broken down step by step. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.
1. ManasFlow, best overall Pipedrive consultant for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that builds go-to-market systems, and our Pipedrive consulting service treats the CRM as the place where everything else lands. We set up the pipeline, stages, fields and permissions, migrate your data, then build the systems that keep Pipedrive accurate without reps doing data entry.

In practice that means enrichment that fills company and contact fields before a rep opens a deal, outbound in Instantly and HeyReach that logs replies to the right person, and n8n jobs that dedupe records, flag deals with no activity and route new leads. Our CRM hygiene automation workflow shows the weekly job we build for most clients.
Pipeline, stage and field design scoped before any import

2. Sales Surge, best for EU teams that want published pricing

Sales Surge is a Platinum Pipedrive partner based in Amstelveen, the Netherlands, with 11 reviews in Pipedrive's marketplace. It implements Pipedrive, HubSpot and Zoho, and covers RevOps, automation, dashboards and AI agents. It also sells its own Pipedrive add-ons (Surge Adopt, Reports, Dedupe, Forms and Reach). Its site claims 150+ CRM implementations and a 2026 Top New ARR Partner Award from Pipedrive.
Own add-ons for adoption, reporting and dedupe
Works with Make, Instantly, Apollo, Clay, PandaDoc and CloudTalk
European B2B teams of 10 to 500 people
Standard implementation €2,950 for up to 5 users
€13,500 for 30 to 50 users; enterprise builds start there
Strong tool coverage for outbound teams
3. MinorCo, best for learning to run Pipedrive yourself

MinorCo is a Platinum Pipedrive partner registered in Auckland with a remote team across the US, Canada, Mexico, Australia and New Zealand. It has 42 reviews in the marketplace and says it was established in 2016. It offers done-for-you builds and done-with-you courses and coaching, plus a sales dashboard pack and a Zapier workflow library.
Courses and coaching for in-house admins
Dashboard pack and Zapier workflow library
Teams that want an internal owner trained to run Pipedrive
Hands-off buyers end up in the custom project range
4. Motii, best for Australia and New Zealand

Motii is a Platinum Pipedrive partner with offices in Melbourne and Sydney and 39 marketplace reviews. It calls itself Australia and New Zealand's leading Pipedrive and monday.com partner and claims Pipedrive ANZ Regional Partner of the Year in 2022, 2024 and 2025. Its services cover implementation, AI and automation, BI, migrations, training and a managed service called MotiiCare.
Pipedrive and monday.com under one partner
Integrations with Make, Zapier, Mailchimp, Intercom, CloudTalk and PandaDoc
ANZ companies running both Pipedrive and monday.com
Regional depth and a large review base
5. Automated Sales, best for sales process design

Automated Sales is a UK consultancy based in Cardiff and a Platinum Pipedrive partner. Its site says it is a Pipedrive Advisory Council member and claims 200+ Pipedrive projects delivered. Services cover pipeline builds, sales strategy, integrations, workflow automation, phased implementations and a fixed-scope setup package.
Sales process design before the build
Zapier, Make, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp and Kixie integrations
Regional pages for the UK, UAE and US
UK teams that want the sales process redesigned along with Pipedrive
6. Flow Digital, best low-cost entry point

Flow Digital is a Brooklyn workflow and AI automation firm with 50 reviews in Pipedrive's marketplace, the most among the firms we checked. Its site describes it as a Certified Pipedrive Gold Partner, but the marketplace lists it at the Authorized tier. It offers Pipedrive, HubSpot, Airtable and Zapier work and a fractional Chief Automation Officer service.
Single paid working session to start
Small teams with one or two specific Pipedrive problems
Lowest entry price on this list
A generalist automation shop rather than a Pipedrive-only firm
7. Axis Consulting, best for migrations into Pipedrive

Axis Consulting is a Miami firm at the Authorized tier with 10 marketplace reviews. It covers Pipedrive implementation, RevOps, CPQ and billing integrations, SOPs and forecasting, and migrates from Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, monday.com and Dynamics. It works on fixed-price engagements with no hourly billing and focuses on financial, professional and field services.
CPQ and billing integrations with Stripe and Chargebee
Teams switching to Pipedrive from a heavier CRM
Lower partner tier and no published prices
Need Pipedrive set up and automated?
We configure your pipelines and migrate your data, then automate follow-ups in Pipedrive. Free 30-minute call.
8. Process Culture, best for Australian SMBs

Process Culture is an Authorized Pipedrive partner in Brighton, Victoria, founded by Peter Burgess, with 11 marketplace reviews. It offers training, consulting, migration, sales process automation and reporting, and connects Pipedrive to ActiveCampaign, MailerLite, Zapier, Make and Ignition.
Australian small businesses tightening their sales process
9. CRM Craft, best for outsourced Pipedrive admin

CRM Craft works as an outsourced in-house Pipedrive team: admin, implementation, training, data-hygiene reports and Slack support. Its site lists co-founder Mark Kofman as a Pipedrive partner since 2012; he also founded the Import2 data migration tool. We could not find CRM Craft in Pipedrive's current marketplace.
Monthly Pipedrive admin with Slack support
Zapier, Make, Mailchimp, QuickBooks and Databox integrations
Teams that need an admin, not a project
